priceNote: Turnaround confirmed · 18A node ramping · foundry thesis maturing
summary: Intel's 18A node has been validated and the foundry turnaround is now confirmed — stock up 500%+ from the lows. At $134, much of the re-rating is priced in. The question is sustained foundry customer wins (MSFT, Apple) and whether Intel can hold margin expansion. Upside exists but the easy money is made.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Intel Foundry catalyst is not a single-day binary event like earnings — it tends to be a multi-week drift after major milestone news. Enter early to capture the drift, not just the spike.

postWin.note: INTC turnaround catalyst history: 18A yield milestone success → +20–30% rapid re-rating. MSFT 18A custom chip win → expected +25–40% from current level

postLose.note: 18A yield miss or customer order cancellation = severe de-rating. Example: INTC Q2 2024 earnings miss → -29% overnight when foundry thesis was unconfirmed

stopPostCatalyst.note: If foundry news is bad (yield miss, customer cancel) — exit fast, no waiting. INTC can gap down -20%+ in 1 day.
